explicacoes.1:
✏️ Option 1: Manual input
You type a question or command, and the AI will respond based on the 'extract_wisdom' pattern.
explicacoes.2:
🎥 Option 2: Video transcription
You provide a YouTube video URL, and the AI will transcribe and summarize it.
explicacoes.3:
🌐 Option 3: Website scraping
You provide a URL, and the textual content will be extracted and analyzed by the AI.
explicacoes.4:
🎨 Option 4: List patterns
The AI will show all available skills (patterns).
explicacoes.5:
🧹 Option 5: Clear context
This removes the conversation history for the current session.
explicacoes.6:
🔄 Option 6: Reset session
Fully restarts the AI session.
